_doc: Preflight-guard — cheap-composition. A DETERMINISTIC transform validates + normalizes the input BEFORE any model call: required-field check, size/limit guard, whitespace normalize. `branch` routes valid input to the (paid) `summarize` agent and garbage to `reject`, which terminates with a clear error and NEVER touches a model. The 'don't pay for a model call on garbage input' pattern — pure wiring, no engine code. The guard is a `transform` (call:envelope) so its result SPREADS onto the payload; it carries `title`/`text` forward so the summarize agent can read them after the guard's payload-replace.
